advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Gate the Cloud compare-fit at outbound_fields.py:586 (and inbound_differ.py:210) on the cutover flag so send-fit and compare-fit remain a single transform.
evidence: outbound_fields.py:586 `local_val = adf.normalize_description(adf.fit_text_to_adf_limit(local_val))` — not gated on cutover_clients()
outbound_fields.py:570-576 comment: normalize local 'the identical way or the differ re-emits a description update forever'
ticket 3388 plan (Cloud): 'compares adf.normalize_description/adf.fit_text_to_adf_limit (outbound_fields.py:586, inbound_differ.py:210) — send-fit and compare-fit must be one transform'
advisory.finding: When Cloud cutover is ON, the send-side fit/normalize uses the rich transform (adf_to_markdown∘markdown_to_adf / fit_markdown_to_adf_limit) but the compare-side at outbound_fields.py:586 is unconditionally the PLAIN transform (adf.normalize_description∘fit_text_to_adf_limit). The two are no longer one transform, so per the code's own comment the differ re-emits a description update every pass and never converges.
scenarios: Cloud cutover enabled: every reconciler pass sees a mismatch between the rich-normalized send value and the plain-normalized compare value, emitting a redundant description update loop

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Make DC rich-mode fit measure the rendered wiki length (fit after render, or a fit_markdown_to_wiki_limit) so a fitted description cannot exceed the DC cap after rendering.
evidence: rich_text.py:132-135 fit_outbound truncates the raw `text` to `WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT` regardless of `self._rich`
rich_text.py:159-161 rich to_wire calls `render_markdown_to_wiki(text)` which can inflate (e.g. tables wrapped in {noformat}, list markers rewritten)
_issues.py:123 create path composes `codec.to_wire(codec.fit_outbound(description))` — fit before render
adf.py:464 fit_markdown_to_adf_limit exists to measure the rendered serialization for Cloud; no DC counterpart
advisory.finding: DC rich-mode fit is measured on the wrong representation: WikiTextCodec.fit_outbound truncates the Markdown source by character count against WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT, but rich to_wire then renders it to wiki markup which can be longer, so to_wire(fit_outbound(x)) can exceed the DC character cap. Cloud avoids this via fit_markdown_to_adf_limit which measures the real serialization; DC has no equivalent.
scenarios: A near-limit DC description whose wiki rendering is longer than its Markdown source is fitted to the cap in Markdown, rendered larger, then rejected by Jira's jira.text.field.character.limit — aborting the create/update
